metadata.description: Agent skills for neural network interpretability with nnsight, nnterp and nnspec, and for running your own NDIF server

plugins.name: nnspec
plugins.description: Interpretability experiments as JSON documents: lenses, patching, ablation, attention, steering, probes, SAEs and DAS with no intervention code

plugins.name: nnterp
plugins.description: Interpretability code written once against one module vocabulary and one set of standard values across 98 transformer families, on nnsight

plugins.name: nnsight
plugins.description: Read and edit the internals of any PyTorch model with nnsight: tracing, interventions, gradients, remote execution on NDIF, debugging, and a guide per interpretability technique

plugins.name: ndif
plugins.description: Run your own NDIF server, the backend behind nnsight's remote=True: stand it up, deploy and size models, fix it, and change its code
